title: Book Two · Chapter 21: Four Saturday Mornings
story:
On Sunday, Ronan sits at the table after breakfast.

Mum is sorting some cloth. Dad is looking for a clean work shirt. Ronan waits. Mum still has a large cloth pile to sort.

“Can I ask about the reading room?”

Mum puts down one piece. “Yes.”

“Can I go there like Leo?”

“Do you know the price?”

“No.”

“Then we need that first.”

Ronan looks at Dad. “Leo brought a paper home.”

“What was on it?”

“A bridge. A story. He put lines under some words.”

“You want to read it?”

“I want a paper like that.”

Dad finds his shirt at last. “Those are two different things.”

Ronan says nothing. He wants the reading room too. He thinks about Leo at a new table with new books. Perhaps Leo will read much faster next week.

Mum puts the cloth into a basket.

“I can ask his mother about the cost. I will ask about the time too.”

She has a customer to see first. Ronan must wait until the afternoon.

He takes out his school book. He reads half a page. Then he looks towards the gate. He reads the same line again because he lost his place.

Mum returns after lunch with a small note. She sits beside Dad. Ronan brings his stool close.

“There are four meetings in a month,” Mum says. “This is the price for one meeting.”

She writes it on their paper. Then she writes the month cost below it.

Ronan points at the first number. “That one looks smaller.”

“It is for one morning. We must count all four.”

There is also the journey. Leo's mother goes with him. She comes back to meet him later. Ronan cannot go there alone.

“Can you take me?” he asks Dad.

“Not on every Saturday. I work at Mr Sun's on some of those mornings.”

“I have customers too,” Mum says.

She puts their own list beside the new note. Food, the room and Dad's journeys to work are on it.

“Can I use the coins in my box?” Ronan asks.

They count his few coins. Most of his savings went into the blue bicycle. The coins do not cover a month of meetings.

“I bought the bike. Now I cannot go,” he says.

“We chose the bike together,” Mum says. “That money is spent. We cannot spend it again.”

Dad moves the coins back towards him.

“We are not paying for this activity today. First we need a plan for the cost and the journeys.”

“Can we ask again?”

“Yes,” Mum says. “Keep the note. We can look at it again with next month's list.”

Ronan wants an earlier answer. He also wants Mum to finish this talk before her next customer comes.

“May I put the note in my box?”

“Of course.”

He puts it beside the coins. He leaves the box shut when Leo passes the gate later.

Leo is going out with his father. He waves and keeps walking. Ronan waves back.

At supper, Dad asks about the school page. Ronan opens his book. He finds the line again and reads it aloud. Mum listens for a moment, then carries the bowls to the kitchen.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- cost＝费用
- meeting＝一次活动、聚会
- cover＝足够支付
- journey＝来回的路程

## 理解问题

1. 父母计算活动费用时，还考虑了哪些安排？
2. Ronan为什么提到已经买下的蓝自行车？

## 从认词到读句子

正文原句：*Mum puts down one piece.*

**Mum / puts down / one piece.**

妈妈／放下／一块布。先找人物Mum，再看动作puts down。
